name: md-requirements-editor
description: Typora-style editable preview for markdown requirements documents — review comments, traceability, and quality checks

commands.title: Requirements: Export Review Comments as CSV

mdreq.requirementPattern.markdownDescription: Example requirement ID (simple mode). Headings whose text starts with an ID of this shape get review/traceability badges — e.g. `REQ_001`, `SRS-0001`. Ignored when `#mdreq.requirementPatternRegex#` is set. Leave both empty to disable requirement detection.

mdreq.requirementPatternRegex.markdownDescription: Advanced: a regular expression for requirement IDs; takes precedence over the simple pattern. It must match at the START of the heading text and capture the full ID in group 1 (or a named group `id`). Example for `TRANS_<Feature>_001` IDs with a variable feature name: `(TRANS_[A-Za-z0-9]+_\d{3})`.

mdreq.requirementPatternRegexFlags.markdownDescription: Flags for `#mdreq.requirementPatternRegex#`, e.g. `i` for case-insensitive matching.

mdreq.newlineBehavior.markdownDescription: What Enter does in a paragraph. `line` (default): one newline in the file; press Enter again on the empty line for a paragraph break (blank line). `paragraph`: classic markdown — Enter always starts a new paragraph; use Shift+Enter for a line break.
